SessionStart.command: cat >/dev/null; (export PATH="$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; command -v session-recall >/dev/null 2>&1 && nohup session-recall sync >/tmp/session-recall-index.log 2>&1 </dev/null &); printf '%s\n' '{}'

Stop.command: cat >/dev/null; (export PATH="$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; command -v session-recall >/dev/null 2>&1 && nohup session-recall sync >/tmp/session-recall-index.log 2>&1 </dev/null &); printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"stop"}'
